name: Park Hyatt St. Kitts
positioning: Beachfront resort on Banana Bay, St. Kitts, with rooftop plunge-pool suites, villas and views across to Nevis (officially Park Hyatt St. Kitts Christophe Harbour)
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a private rooftop plunge pool
Families using the complimentary kids club for ages 3 to 12
Groups wanting a villa with its own pool and kitchen

facts.text: The resort is in Banana Bay on the South East Peninsula of St. Kitts.
Rooms, suites and villas have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the sea and the neighboring island of Nevis.
The One Bedroom Bi-Level Villa is a private two-story villa with a rooftop swimming pool, a fully stocked kitchen and laundry facilities.
The Three Bedroom Presidential Villa has a game room and a private infinity pool.
Destination Dining includes dining barefoot on the beach in the evening.
Island Fort by Camp Hyatt is a complimentary kids club for children ages 3 to 12.
Non-motorized watersports, including kayaking, paddle boarding and snorkeling, are covered by the resort fee.
A rum tasting class is offered with advance reservation.
Water taxi transportation to and from Nevis is available.
Park Hyatt St. Kitts is a Green Key Certified hotel.
The resort is pet-friendly for up to one dog or cat per room.
The resort has a pickleball court with mountain views.

highlights.text: Plunge Pool Rooftop suites have a private plunge pool on a rooftop sun deck.
Fisherman's Village offers over-the-water dining with island-inspired cuisine in a casual atmosphere.
Sugar Mill Spa & Sanctuary has a yoga and meditation room inside a former sugar mill.
The architecture of Great House restaurant reflects the grand houses that once stood at the center of each estate on St. Kitts.
Stone Barn fuses Peruvian and Japanese cuisine.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee applies to each room.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires connecting flights.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
